verdicts.reason: A reads properly left to right (hashtag bar, headline, list, doctor with CTA), but the list is jammed right up against 'SYMPTOMS' with no gutter, wraps badly ('of breath', 'Pain in / chest'), and the yellow CTA under the doctor is small. B leaves the left third empty, so the composition sits lopsided; it merges list items into run-on lines ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache'), blows the sparkle up into a focal point, and shrinks the CTA and hashtag text until they're hard to read.
